board.label: Sumbreak board, {size} by {size}. Arrow keys move. Enter picks up a tile, and Enter on an equal neighbour drops it there.
board.partner: Can take the tile you picked up.

idle.start: Drag a number onto an equal neighbour. They merge into their sum, and the last tile will be {total}.
idle.progress: {left} tiles left. The last one will be {total}.

status.reset: Board reset. The clock keeps running.
status.stuck: No merges left. Undo, or ask for a hint to go back to the last position that can be finished.

error.empty-source: There is no tile to move there.
error.not-adjacent: Only neighbours merge: side by side, or one above the other.
error.empty-target: Tiles do not move into empty cells. A tile only merges into an equal neighbour.
error.different: Numbers must be identical: {from} and {to} do not merge.

hint.merge: The smallest number goes first. Drop the {value} in row {row}, column {column} onto the {value} {direction, select, right {to its right} left {to its left} below {below it} other {above it}}: {why, select, onlyPair {it is the only pair of them.} onlySafe {of the {total} ways to merge the {value}s, it is the only one that leaves a board that can be finished.} other {{alive} of the {total} ways to merge the {value}s leave a board that can be finished, and this is one.}}

deadEnd.odd-count: There {count, plural, =1 {is one {smallest}} other {are # {smallest}s}} left, and the smallest number can only pair up with itself. The board goes back to the last position that can still be finished.
deadEnd.split: The tiles are split into groups that no longer touch, and tiles never move. The board goes back to the last position that can still be finished.
deadEnd.lonely: A {smallest} has no equal neighbour left, and nothing can bring one to it. The board goes back to the last position that can still be finished.
deadEnd.search: From here every order of merges gets stuck. The board goes back to the last position that can still be finished.

tutorial.title: How to play Sumbreak

merge.title: Merge equal neighbours
merge.body: Drag a number onto a neighbour that holds the same number, or tap one and then the other. They become one tile with their sum. Start with the two 1s.

order.title: The order is the puzzle
order.body: The tile you drop on keeps its place, the other cell stays empty, and nothing slides. A 2 that ends up far from the other 2 is stuck for good. Keep merging, and use Undo if you strand a tile.

tutorial.doneBody: One tile left, holding the sum of all the others. A merge that looks fine can still ruin the board, and the game only tells you when you get stuck or ask for a hint. The clock starts when you first see a board and only stops when it is solved.
